title: SWF v8 compiler & publish
description: Walk document model → SWF tag stream: header, FileAttributes, DefineShape/DefineShape4, DefineSprite, PlaceObject2, ShowFrame, End. Correct twips, tag ordering, scene concatenation. Publish (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter) writes .swf. See docs/14-publishing-export.md, docs/15-file-formats-fla-swf.md. Depends on document-model-mvp, vector-engine-mvp, symbols-library-mvp.
